[[File:Mithril plateskirt detail.png|120px|left]]
'''Mithril plateskirts''' give the fifth best stat bonuses of all [[plateskirt]]s. This piece of armour can be made with Level 66 [[Smithing]] by using 3 [[mithril bar]]s on an [[anvil]], therefore granting the player with 150 smithing experience. At least 20 [[Defence]] is required to wear it. Mithril plateskirts have similar stats to [[mithril platelegs]] but weigh less.
